Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue; use
`Closes #N` only when integration satisfies its entire delivery contract.

Validation: commands, source/artifact identity and results. Separate automated
checks from manual emulator and physical results; state meaningful limitations.

- [ ] Public staged-source gate and relevant checks pass; no original inputs or derived assets staged.
- [ ] Independent review addressed; local issue and durable handoff updated.
- [ ] New testable ROM, if any: versioned release with exact ROM/hash/commit and human test instructions.
- [ ] Project item remains `In review` until its delivery conditions pass.
